Issue Description: Customer FF App signed out automatically multiple times
Resolution Details:
28-Jul: Issue identified: Network drop scenario when user transitions to Homescreen and subsequent JWT token authentication failure causing logout method being called. 

Analysis: The investigation traced this to the JWT refresh flow, where the interceptor treated any failure during token regeneration — a bad server response or an unrelated exception — as if it meant the session itself was invalid, and force-logged the user out as a result. In this case the network drop was invalidating the session and forcing log out

Action: Scenario handled by ensuring "Logout"  fires only when the server explicitly signals the session is no longer valid (403). Transient failures and unrelated exceptions in the refresh flow no longer force users out of the app.
